episodes.title: Rainbow Hong, Shining Rang - My Brother Hongrang
episodes.summary: Twelve years after Sim Hongrang's sudden disappearance, a man seeming to be him appears — passing all the tests. Yet Sim Jae-yi remains unconvinced.

episodes.title: The One Who Stole Our World
episodes.summary: Jae-yi and Hongrang separately search for a ghost rumored to be abducting children. In their search, peril strikes Jae-yi — but Hongrang is at her rescue.

episodes.title: The Most Authentic Replica
episodes.summary: After Hongrang's act of heroism, Jae-yi begins to question her doubts. Sim Mu-jin schemes to expose Hongrang's identity at his birthday celebration.

episodes.title: Our Reflective Scars
episodes.summary: Learning of Min Yeon-ui's plans, Sim Yeol-guk devises a counterattack. Hongrang struggles with his conscience after being assigned a terrible task.

episodes.title: The Thicker the Veil, the Clearer the Heart
episodes.summary: As she learns more about Hongrang's past, Jae-yi begins to care for him. Later, Hongrang and Mu-jin suspect Lady Min's scheme to marry Jae-yi off.

episodes.title: Nothing Mu, Finished Jin - Brother Mu-jin
episodes.summary: As plans to stop Jae-yi's arrangement fail, she finds herself in a dangerous bind. The opposition between Yeol-guk and Yeon-ui reaches a boiling point.

episodes.title: Roaring Waves
episodes.summary: As Mu-jin's fate remains dire, Jae-yi attempts to do whatever it takes to save him. Later, news of a dead child returning spreads, alarming Hongrang.

episodes.title: Imperfect Jae, Departing Yi - My Name is Jae-yi
episodes.summary: Jae-yi decides to leave with Mu-jin despite her feelings for Hongrang. Yeol-guk initiates damage control after discovering a conspiracy against him.

episodes.title: The Living Offering
episodes.summary: A manhunt for Hongrang and Jae-yi ensues, putting them in grave danger. As they hide, their bond deepens, facing threats and challenges together.

episodes.title: A Bittersweet Farewell
episodes.summary: With Hongrang captured, Yeol-guk attempts to restore the guild in his name. But Grand Prince Hanpyeong wastes no time putting his grand plan into motion.

episodes.title: Forever and After
episodes.summary: The truth about Hongrang is revealed, but enemies remain. In the end, will he be able to save Jae-yi and free himself from the shackles of his past?
